g:structured_title.g:content: Roun Groun Portable Butane Camping Stove - Khaki

g:structured_description.g:content: A portable butane camping stove for outdoor cooking with a stainless-steel case, aluminium bracket, copper gas tube, adjustable flame and built-in piezo ignition. Includes one stove, travel bag and manual. Folded dimensions are 25 x 8.3 x 11 cm; listed weight is 1,400 g. Listed maximum output is 2,600 W and gas consumption is 120 g/hour, depending on conditions. A compatible butane camping-stove can is required. Check the supplied manual for the cartridge connection and safety instructions. Fuel is not listed among the package contents. Selected colour is Khaki.

g:structured_description.g:content: A 50 ml magnesium carbonate liquid chalk formula for gymnastics, weightlifting and calisthenics. Includes one bottle and a carry clip. The supplied packaging lists magnesium carbonate, SDA alcohol, hydroxypropylcellulose and colophonium. Shake before use, spread evenly on hands and allow to dry before gripping equipment. Follow the complete bottle label and skin-test guidance. Avoid eyes, broken skin and ingestion; stop use if irritation occurs.

g:structured_title.g:content: Roun Groun Semi-Transparent PVC Tote Bag, White

g:structured_description.g:content: A reusable white semi-transparent PVC tote for beach days, shopping and everyday carry. Includes one bag with handles and button closure. Listed body dimensions are 30 x 7 x 23.5 cm with 20 cm handles; listed weight is 500 g. Easy-to-clean PVC body. Venue bag policies vary; check entry rules before travel. Water-resistant material does not make the closure watertight. Protect valuables separately and avoid sharp items and overloading.

g:structured_title.g:content: Roun Groun Titanium Safety Whistle with Reflective Lanyard

g:structured_description.g:content: A compact titanium-alloy safety whistle for hiking, camping and sports, with a pea-less uni-tone design and reflective red lanyard. Includes one whistle with lanyard. Keep it accessible and check operation before an outing. A whistle is an additional signalling aid, not a guarantee of rescue or audibility. Keep the air passage clear, avoid blowing near ears and use the lanyard carefully to prevent snagging.
